# netbox_contacts (Data Source)

Lists contact objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contacts" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-contact" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: address, address__empty, address__ic, address__ie, address__iew, address__iregex, address__isw, address__n, address__nic, address__nie, address__niew, address__nisw, address__regex, created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, email, email__empty, email__ic, email__ie, email__iew, email__iregex, email__isw, email__n, email__nic, email__nie, email__niew, email__nisw, email__regex, group, group__n, group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, link, link__empty, link__ic, link__ie, link__iew, link__iregex, link__isw, link__n, link__nic, link__nie, link__niew, link__nisw, link__regex, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner, owner__n, owner_group, owner_group__n, owner_group_id, owner_group_id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, phone, phone__empty, phone__ic, phone__ie, phone__iew, phone__iregex, phone__isw, phone__n, phone__nic, phone__nie, phone__niew, phone__nisw, phone__regex, q, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tag_id, tag_id__any, tag_id__n, title, title__empty, title__ic, title__ie, title__iew, title__iregex, title__isw, title__n, title__nic, title__nie, title__niew, title__nisw, title__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `contacts` (Attributes List) The matching contacts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts))

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--contacts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of contact groups this contact belongs to.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `link` (String) URL related to the contact.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `phone` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `title` (String)
- `url` (String)
